claim: This package covers all 13 current ranked ValueRank model IDs, in rank order, across seven first-party providers.
OpenAI publishes dynamic Codex/Work meter behavior and message estimates, but no fixed token/API-dollar allowance for each plan and ranked model; unmatched API IDs remain unpriced.
Anthropic publishes Pro/Max plan prices and relative Max tiers, not an absolute model-specific token/API-dollar allowance; paid usage credits are separate from plan inclusion.
xAI exposes a shared weekly pool without an absolute API-dollar limit; Grok 4.7 subscription access is unverified from the inspected current consumer pricing page.
Google publishes regional plan prices and compute-based relative limits; the consumer Gemini 3 Flash label is not proven to be the API ID gemini-3.8-flash, so a plan/API equivalent is not computable.

Kimi publishes current CNY tiers and shared credits, but model-tier mapping and current Kimi Code reset policy are unresolved across first-party pages; no subscription API-dollar equivalent is computable.
Z.AI's GLM-5.3 Coding Plan is the only reviewed first-party subscription with enough exact-model credit coefficients and API prices for a bounded theoretical API-price-equivalent calculation.
Alibaba publishes exact Qwen plan tier credit caps and qwen3.8-max API rates, but no deterministic Token Plan credit conversion; therefore the plan's API-dollar allowance is N/C.
The provider-by-plan table does not rank plan value across currencies or heterogeneous quota units; the only API-dollar range shown is a bounded GLM-5.3 theoretical conversion, not end-user usage.
Provider-published rates and subscription allowances are not user-reported value multiples and do not enter the separate four-column end-user report table.
